mapper.select: SELECT KINDERGARTEN_ID, NUM, TITLE, PINNED, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(UPDATED_AT) * 1000 UPDATED_AT FROM T_NOTICE WHERE KINDERGARTEN_ID = #{kindergartenId} ORDER BY PINNED DESC, NUM DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_NOTICE(KINDERGARTEN_ID, NUM, TITLE, PINNED, CONTENT, AUTHOR) VALUES (#{kindergartenId}, (SELECT IFNULL(MAX(N.NUM), 0) + 1 FROM T_NOTICE N WHERE N.KINDERGARTEN_ID = #{kindergartenId}), #{title}, #{pinned}, #{content}, #{author})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM T_NOTICE WHERE KINDERGARTEN_ID = #{kindergartenId} AND NUM = #{num}
